vectors.description: A single path gets explicit initial paint.

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <path d="M 0 0 L 24 24" fill="#000000" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: Rectangle defaults and radius resolution: a lone rx copies to ry; no radius writes 0 0.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="2" y="3" width="10" height="8" rx="2"/><rect width="4" height="4"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <rect x="2" y="3" width="10" height="8" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#000000" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="4" height="4" rx="0" ry="0" fill="#000000" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: Circle with a named fill color.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5" fill="red"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5" fill="#ff0000" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#000000" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: Line with a short hexadecimal stroke.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="24" y2="24" stroke="#000"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="24" y2="24" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polyline points="0,0 10,5 20,0" fill="none" stroke="#123456" stroke-width="2"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <polyline points="0 0 10 5 20 0" fill="none" stroke="#123456" stroke-width="2" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: Polygon with mixed comma and space separators.

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <polygon points="12 2 22 22 2 22" fill="#000000" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: Every transform function; translate and scale gain their implicit argument; group opacity stays on the group.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><g transform="translate(5) scale(2) rotate(45) rotate(10, 12, 12) skewX(10) skewY(-5) matrix(1,0,0,1,3,4)" opacity="0.5"><path d="M0 0H4"/></g></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <g transform="translate(5 0) scale(2 2) rotate(45) rotate(10 12 12) skewX(10) skewY(-5) matrix(1 0 0 1 3 4)" opacity="0.5">
    <path d="M 0 0 H 4" fill="#000000" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>

vectors.description: Every path command, implicit repetitions, abutting numbers and compact arc flags; case and relativity are kept.

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <path d="M 1 1 L 2 2 m 1 -1 l 1 1 L 3 3 l 1 1 H 5 h 1 V 6 v 1 C 1 1 2 2 3 3 c 1 1 2 2 3 3 c 1 1 2 2 3 3 S 4 4 5 5 s 1 1 2 2 Q 1 1 2 2 q 1 1 2 2 T 3 3 t 1 1 A 5 5 0 0 1 10 10 a 5 5 30 1 0 0.5 0.5 Z z" fill="#000000" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: Every paint property with a non-initial value, given in arbitrary order.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path opacity="0.75" stroke-dashoffset="1px" stroke-dasharray="4,2 1" stroke-miterlimit="10" stroke-linejoin="bevel" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2px" stroke-opacity=".5" stroke="#00f" fill-rule="evenodd" fill-opacity="0.25" fill="#0F0" d="M0 0H10V10Z"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <path d="M 0 0 H 10 V 10 Z" fill="#00ff00" fill-opacity="0.25" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#0000ff" stroke-opacity="0.5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="bevel" stroke-miterlimit="10" stroke-dasharray="4 2 1" stroke-dashoffset="1" opacity="0.75"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: Linear gradient in defs gets explicit defaults and the canonical ID p1.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><defs><linearGradient id="sky"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="navy" stop-opacity=".8"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="24" height="24" fill="url(#sky)"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="p1" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%" spreadMethod="pad">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000080" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="24" height="24" rx="0" ry="0" fill="url(#p1)" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: Radial gradient outside defs, referenced before it is declared, moves into defs; fx and fy default to cx and cy; rgb() becomes hexadecimal.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" fill="url(#glow)"/><radialGradient id="glow" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" spreadMethod="reflect" gradientTransform="scale(1 0.5)"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="rgb(255, 128, 0)"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000"/></radialGradient></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="p1" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" fx="12" fy="12" fr="0%" spreadMethod="reflect" gradientTransform="scale(1 0.5)">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff8000" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="1"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" fill="url(#p1)" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: User-space clip path on a primitive; clip geometry carries no paint.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><clipPath id="half"><rect width="12" height="24"/></clipPath><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" clip-path="url(#half)" fill="#c00"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <defs>
    <clipPath id="c1" clipPathUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="12" height="24" rx="0" ry="0"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>
  <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" clip-path="url(#c1)" fill="#cc0000" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: Bounding-box clip path with a transform and evenodd clip-rule on a group; paint on clip geometry is validated and discarded.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><defs><clipPath id="k" clipPathUnits="objectBoundingBox" transform="translate(0.1 0.1)"><path d="M0 0H.5V.5Z" clip-rule="evenodd" fill="red"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#k)"><rect width="24" height="24"/></g></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <defs>
    <clipPath id="c1" clipPathUnits="objectBoundingBox" transform="translate(0.1 0.1)">
      <path d="M 0 0 H 0.5 V 0.5 Z" clip-rule="evenodd"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>
  <g clip-path="url(#c1)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="24" height="24" rx="0" ry="0" fill="#000000" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>
